title: agent-cmd-pace-exempt
desc: Agent.cmd blocked by pace guard: root cause in Test-WkPaceExempt, fix pattern agent-dot not agent-word-boundary, ACK gate deadlock
steps: ROOT CAUSE: Bash(Agent.cmd ...) bypasses haiku/Agent ToolName checks in Test-WkPaceExempt (wkharness-common-classify.ps1). wk-prefix check passes wkappbot/wkcodex etc but NOT Agent.cmd -- it lacks the wk- prefix. So pace guard blocks Agent.cmd same as any other Bash call.

FIX (698339f0 2026-07-01): insert after Test-WkPrefixCommand check -- if ToolName in Bash/PS/shell_command AND Command matches agent-dot or wkcodex-or-codex -> return true. File: wkharness-common-classify.ps1 L93.

PATTERN: use agent. (with dot) NOT agent-word-boundary. Reason: word-boundary treats = as boundary so agent=foo (env-var) matches and gets false-exempted. agent. requires literal dot -- covers Agent.cmd/Agent.ps1, not agent=x. User insight 2026-07-01.
TEST: run Agent.cmd after fix. Proof = hits DIFFERENT guard (agent-brief-guard or diet-score), not pace-95. Different error = pace gate cleared.

OPEN FIX-B/C: ACK gate (wkharness-guards-pace.ps1 L529-548) deadlocks. Marker re-created with current timestamp each call -> _userReplied=false even after user replies. FIX-B: on JSON parse fail set acked=true. FIX-C: call Test-WkPaceExempt in ACK gate before Block() so Agent dispatches escape even when not acked.

MISTAKE LOG 2026-07-01: user said fix Agent.cmd -> first removed it from error message (bad commit af3a557c) instead of making it work. LESSON: fix X means make X work, not delete X. Read intent first.
